tool_args.rationale: The thermal-fin bridge maps to the two-layer siphon, but the pilot varies only u_now. A gradient-varying branch probe can distinguish the sink response and branch term before fitting.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All five pilot rows have the same sink gradient, so sink inhibition and the open branch are not separately identified.
The bridge and flux-conservation signatures favor a static siphon; a memory trajectory is not yet the most discriminating measurement.
It does not resolve the mechanism ambiguity.
